record.reason: KVGov binds KV-cache keys to authenticated tenants to prevent prompt reconstruction through timing attacks; the paper reports HMAC salting reduces attack success to zero. Its primary objective is security, not inference efficiency. It nevertheless quantifies serving-path overhead (+1.3 microseconds per cache-key lookup) and lost cross-tenant prefix reuse, so it is closely related to KV-cache serving trade-offs but is only borderline for this inference-optimization collection.
record.title: Governing the KV Cache: Preventing Timing Side-Channel Leakage in Multi-Tenant LLM Inference
